run_generate_builds: run the script to generate preprocessed abseil-cpp builds YAML from Bazel and CMake rules
parse_bazel_rule: parse a Bazel XML rule element into a Rule namedtuple with normalized paths and dependencies
parse_cmake_rule: parse an absl CMake rule string into a Rule namedtuple by extracting NAME, SRCS, HDRS, and DEPS
pairing_bazel_and_cmake_rules: pair Bazel cc_library rules with CMake absl_cc_library rules based on source file list similarity
collect_bazel_rules: recursively collect all Bazel cc rules from BUILD.bazel files under a given root path
